_comment: COVERAGE DECLARATION -- which (calculator x language) cells we intend to translate.
ROADMAP Task 203 decided the model; Task 204 built this. Read Task 203 before editing.
THIS IS NOT translation_exempt_keys.json AND MUST NEVER BECOME IT.
exempt       = identical to English is PERMANENTLY CORRECT here (symbols, eponyms, cognates).
out of scope = not translated yet, BY DECISION, and revisitable the moment a cell earns it.
Merging the two would destroy the delta-zero discipline built in Task 161: an exempt key is
finished, an out-of-scope key is simply not started, and a tool that cannot tell them apart
reports one permanent number that everybody learns to ignore.
THE RULE (one sentence, two tiers per axis, no per-cell table):
a cell is IN SCOPE iff the calculator is core OR the language is core.
That OR is what makes it a CROSS rather than an intersection: every language gets the core
calculators, and every calculator gets the core languages. An AND rule would leave
Manning-Pipe-Flow untranslated in 22 languages, which is the opposite of the decision.
IDENTITY STRINGS ARE THE FLOOR AND ARE NEVER OUT OF SCOPE -- menu entry, <title> and
*_main_desc stay translated for every calculator in every language, because they are the
discovery mechanism. A cell outside the cross means 'body in English, findable in the local
language', which is also what lets that cell earn its way in.
A prefix not listed in calculator_prefixes is suite chrome (nav, units, install, contact) and
is ALWAYS in scope. That default fails safe: an unclassified new prefix gets translated.
_core_calculators_comment: lpn joined 2026-08-11 (ROADMAP Task 251). Tom decided this on 2026-08-09 and the decision was
written up then; the one-line edit here was never made, so for two days every counter reported
lpn as out of scope and the standing debt was understated by ~22 languages x 230 keys. Tom
found it by saying 'remember that we have moved lpn to top-tier meaning 26 languages' -- which
was true of the decision and false of the file. A decision that lives only in a task block is
not in effect: THIS FILE is what the tools read.
The promotion is deliberately NOT the sprint. Task 251's gate is English stability, and lpn_ is
still moving. Declaring scope makes the debt visible and honest; paying it needs Tom's word.
_identity_key_extra_comment: Three calculators predate the *_main_menu convention and name their menu entry
<prefix>_menu. They are listed by exact key rather than by a '_menu' suffix rule,
because that suffix also matches ordinary body strings -- lpn_tab_menu ('Project menu')
and lpn_backdrop_menu ('Background image...') are UI labels, not identity strings, and a
suffix rule silently promoted both to the never-out-of-scope floor.
_frontier_note: 108 cells of 416 = 26% of the work for 98.2% of measured use (Task 203's efficient frontier).
Moving along that frontier is a one-line edit here: adding a core LANGUAGE costs (16 - N) cells,
adding a core CALCULATOR costs a full 26, which is why the frontier prefers languages.
HW does not earn core status until 156 cells -- 2.9% of use does not justify 26 cells.
lpn was added as a core CALCULATOR anyway (Task 251), against that arithmetic and knowingly:
the 26-language claim is what this suite says lpn IS, and shipping it in four was the claim
being false rather than the frontier being wrong.
